Should the output be the number of distinct triples (i,j,k) or just the number of positions where such a pattern exists (e.g., counting each center j only once)?
Is the comparison case-sensitive? The clarification says A, B, C are uppercase letters, but does S contain only uppercase letters as per constraints?
What if the string contains characters other than A, B, C? Are we only counting triples where S_i, S_j, S_k are exactly 'A', 'B', 'C' respectively?
Does the order of i, j, k strictly require i < j < k, or could they be in any order as long as the characters appear in order A then B then C in the string?

If multiple triples share the same i, j, k indices but differ in some other way (impossible here), should they be counted multiple times?
